==Dialogue==
:''"Beyond this place lies the [[Domain of Anguish]], the last bastion of [[Abaddon]]'s forces. The [[Margonite]]s and their demonic allies are lead by [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] from his [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx|Ebony Citadel]] high above in the Heart of Anguish. For [[Kormir]] to take up the mantle of [[Goddess of Truth]], all traces of Abaddon and his worshippers{{sic|worshipers}} must be eradicated."''
